title: Website API keys
intro: Keys let your websites read your inventory and send leads to Inmolink. Secret keys are for servers (the WordPress plugin, integrations) and must never appear in a web page. Publishable keys are for the browser widget and only work on the websites you list.

create.title: Create a key
create.name: Name
create.originsHint: One per line, for example https://www.example.com. List www and non-www separately. Use http://localhost:3000 only for local testing.

issued.title: Copy your new key now
issued.intro: This is the only time we show it. Store it somewhere safe; if you lose it, rotate the key to get a new one.

notices.revoked: The key was revoked. Websites using it stop working within a minute.

errors.FORBIDDEN: Only agency admins can manage API keys.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That key no longer exists or was already revoked.
errors.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: API keys unlock once our team has verified your company.
errors.API_KEY_LIMIT_REACHED: You have reached the maximum number of active keys. Revoke one you no longer use first.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Please check the form: a name, at least one permission and, for publishable keys, at least one website address (https://…) and read permissions only (leads and viewing requests need a secret key).
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
